exposure: GDM/International Association of Diabetes in Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG): abnormal 3 hour OGTT by the IADPSG criteria
elevated GCT + normal oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT): abnormal 1 hour GCT + normal 3 hour OGTT
cohort: 5,937 women with a singleton pregnancy who completed GDM screening between 24 to 32 weeks gestational age
finding: Little difference in birth outcomes was found between the two criteria, GDM/CC and GDM/IADPSG.
